name: SAE_single_benchmark
description: SAE_single_benchmark evaluates model behavior under targeted context modifications to assess robustness and sensitivity to contextual perturbations. It provides single-instance examples where context is altered and measures whether models maintain correct answers or outputs despite irrelevant or adversarial context changes. The benchmark is intended to probe context-dependence and robustness rather than broad general knowledge.
reputation: A specialized benchmark with limited but growing use among researchers studying context robustness and adversarial context modifications.
